why: Withdraw is public but pays only the Stark key's registered Ethereum owner, never the unrelated caller. Verified implementation 0x273b65a7231321d4ee47a4c47408ef43517455ec, LegacyStarkExchangeBridge.sol lines 58-70: recipient = strictGetEthKey(ownerKey); _transferOut(recipient,...). At parent block 26425096 of tx 0xf1de7a13694d3ea230671f28d635e0b417968b36522cd77b3a5d487903e4e0cd, eth_call from fresh 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000ca11ce succeeds, and debug_traceCall shows OMI token transfer to 0x3d8ab09cea91fe61fa6e05afd2456728f0b9f69d, matching getEthKey(ownerKey), rather than to caller. The receipt's two withdrawals paid 0x3d8ab09c and 0xfdc45e8a, not the submitting 0x0000004edefe5fc2fb75467d4fe822ea3d0f4444. Official Immutable guide explicitly confirms anyone may call but payment always follows getEthKey: https://github.com/immutable/imx-migration-contracts/blob/main/docs/finalise-pending-withdrawals.md. Prior ~$370/7d was owners' principal, not a public reward.
next_steps: Closed for the farm's public-reward strategy. Reopen only if a documented, on-chain claim purchase mechanism gives the bot ownership of a claim with a positive one-transaction margin; do not treat other users' escrowed withdrawals as earnings.
